en.text: Project Overview
Academy Nafia is an Islamic education platform that provides books, Arabic learning materials, study resources, and educational courses for students and learners.

The organization needed a professional online bookstore where visitors could explore available resources, understand product details, and purchase educational materials conveniently from desktop and mobile devices.
Webnion designed and developed a responsive e-commerce website that presents Academy Nafia’s educational products in a clean, organized, and user-friendly way.
The Challenge

Academy Nafia offered different types of learning resources, including Islamic books, Arabic handwriting materials, course content, and educational packages. The main challenge was to organize these resources clearly without making the website difficult to navigate.
The website also needed to reflect the organization’s educational and Islamic identity while providing a modern and accessible shopping experience for students, parents, and learners.
Our Solution
We created a responsive educational e-commerce website focused on clear product presentation, simple navigation, and convenient online purchasing.

items: Clean and professional educational website design
Clear presentation of books and learning materials
Easy access to account and checkout pages
Brand-focused design based on Academy Nafia’s identity

en.text: Design Approach

The website uses a warm and minimal design style that matches Academy Nafia’s educational identity. Neutral backgrounds, brown accents, clean product cards, and simple typography create a calm and professional visual experience.
The homepage was structured to guide visitors from the main promotional banner to featured books, Arabic learning materials, course resources, and clear purchasing actions.
Online Bookstore Experience

Each product is presented with a clear image, title, price, discount information, and add-to-cart button. This allows visitors to understand available learning resources and choose the most suitable option easily.
The website structure also gives Academy Nafia the flexibility to add more books, educational packages, notebooks, and course materials in the future.
Mobile Experience
The website was optimized for mobile users so students and customers can browse educational products, check prices, add items to the cart, and contact Academy Nafia conveniently from smaller screens.
Important navigation links, product information, action buttons, and contact options remain accessible throughout the mobile shopping experience.
Business Value
The completed website gives Academy Nafia a professional digital platform for presenting and selling Islamic educational resources online.
It helps the organization improve product visibility, simplify the purchasing process, strengthen its online presence, and make valuable learning materials more accessible to students and learners.
